description: This file contains HTTP handlers for managing node-related operations in an agent control plane. It processes lease updates, action acknowledgments, claims, and shutdown notifications from agents, utilizing various internal services and storage.

methods.name: NodeStatusLeaseHandler
methods.description: Handles lease-based status updates from agents, updating their status and heartbeat, and returning next lease info.

methods.name: NodeActionAckHandler
methods.description: Acknowledges agent actions, renews leases, and updates heartbeat.

methods.name: ClaimActionsHandler
methods.description: Returns pending actions for poll-mode agents and renews heartbeat and lease.

methods.name: NodeShutdownHandler
methods.description: Processes graceful shutdown notifications from agents, updating status and heartbeat, and removing presence.
